Subiect: turn LN outreach into a pipeline machine

Conținut:
Image

Hi GTM operator 👋

How's your LinkedIn outreach going so far? First impressions of HeyReach?

 

Feel free to share them, I read all replies. 🙂

 

Last email I promised you the blueprint for turning LinkedIn outreach into a predictable pipeline machine in under 30 days. Here it comes.

 

But first, the honest math. I pulled every campaign run through HeyReach last quarter. Users received 1.64 million replies at a 26% average reply rate. And 37% of those replies were interested leads — the ones who end up booking a call.

 

Here's what that means for one sender account in one month:

* 400 connection requests
* 21% avg acceptance → ~84 new connections
* 26% avg reply rate → ~22 conversations
* 37% interested → ~8 qualified leads
Eight real conversations with people who want to talk. From one account. Multiply by your close rate and your average deal value.

 

Then add a second sender. And a third. That's the part that makes your CEO sit up. (If you are the CEO, you're already smiling.)

 

Suddenly you're not doing "LinkedIn outreach."

 

You're running a system with a known input and a predictable output.

 

Here's how to build it ⤵️

Play ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GpDV4RW06wE&utm_campaign=Onboarding+Flow&utm_content=Blueprint+email&utm_medium=email_action&utm_source=customer.io )

Happy hunting,

 

Vuk, CMO @ HeyReach

Feel free to share them, I read all replies. 🙂

 

Last email I promised you the blueprint for turning LinkedIn outreach into a predictable pipeline machine in under 30 days. Here it comes.

 

But first, the honest math. I pulled every campaign run through HeyReach last quarter. Users received 1.64 million replies at a 26% average reply rate. And 37% of those replies were interested leads — the ones who end up booking a call.

 

Here's what that means for one sender account in one month:

* 400 connection requests
* 21% avg acceptance → ~84 new connections
* 26% avg reply rate → ~22 conversations
* 37% interested → ~8 qualified leads
Eight real conversations with people who want to talk. From one account. Multiply by your close rate and your average deal value.

 

Then add a second sender. And a third. That's the part that makes your CEO sit up. (If you are the CEO, you're already smiling.)

 

Suddenly you're not doing "LinkedIn outreach."

 

You're running a system with a known input and a predictable output.
